body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application.

br.br:
1. (Canceled) An intravascular device, comprising:an elongate member having a proximal end, a distal end, and an inner lumen extending between the proximal end and the distal end;
a ring electrode disposed at the distal end of the elongate member;
an ultrasound asensor disposed at a distal end of the ring electrode;
a first electrical conductor configured to convey an electrocardiogram signal from the ring electrode to a processor; and
an adaptor member connecting the first electrical conductor to the ring electrode;
wherein a distal portion of the tapered distal segment is attached to the adaptor member and a distal portion of the adaptor member is attached to the ring electrode.
2. (New) An intravascular device, comprising:
a stylet comprising an elongate member having a proximal end, a distal end, and an inner lumen extending between the proximal end and the distal end;
a hub having an inner lumen for receiving the stylet;
a guard extending from a distal end of the hub, and having an inner lumen for receiving and stabilizing the stylet; and
a connector assembly proximal to the stylet, configured for connecting one or more elements of the stylet to a computing device.
3. (New) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the stylet comprises a plurality of sensors disposed on the distal end.
4. (New) The intravascular device of claim 3, wherein the plurality of sensors comprises one or more selected from an ultrasound transducer, a pressure sensor, a temperature sensor, an optical sensor, a biosensor, or one or more combinations thereof.
5. (New) The intravascular device of claim 4, wherein the biosensor comprises an ECG electrode.
6. (New) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein, the hub is configured to engage with the stylet wherein when in an engaged configuration, a rotation applied to the hub can cause a rotation to the stylet.
7. (New) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the hub and the connector assembly are configured to allow relative movement between them so that movement of the hub does not cause movement of at least the portion of the connector assembly.
8. (New) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the hub is configured to removably engage with the connector assembly so that the hub and connector assembly can rotate together, and wherein the connector assembly further comprises a stabilizing portion that rotates independent of the connector assembly such that the connection to the computing device is stable when the hub and connector assembly rotate.
9. (New) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the connector assembly is configured to attach or plug into a port in a computer.
10. (New) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the connector assembly is configured to attach to one or more cords or wires that attach to or plug into a computer.
11. (New) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the intravascular device has a length L1 and the stylet has a length L2, wherein L2 is less than L1.
12. (New) The intravascular device of claim 11, wherein is L1 is about two times L2.
13. (New) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the one or more elements comprise a coaxial cable that connects to an ultrasound transducer.
Office Action Dated: January 13, 2023
14. (New) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the one or more elements comprise an electrical conductor comprising a conductive wire that connects to an ECG electrode.
